title: Reduce GPU memory & workspace usage: activation checkpointing refinements, arena tuning, and scratch buffer pooling
author: Ethan Park
description: Motivation: Reduce peak GPU memory and workspace requirements for high-concurrency workloads to avoid OOMs and improve tail latency. This PR combines three complementary changes: 1) refine activation checkpointing to reduce intermediate allocation footprint, 2) tune the arena allocator thresholds and evictions to better reuse scratch memory across requests, and 3) introduce a lightweight scratch buffer pooling layer for commonly used temporary buffers. Together these changes target memory-bound inference (longer sequence lengths, multiple concurrent streams) and improve headroom for continuous batching and KV cache residency. Changes are backwards-compatible: allocator tuning is configurable and disabled by default for private deployments until validated. Key results from internal perf runs (NVIDIA A100, mixed-precision LLMs): ~18-28% reduction in peak GPU memory depending on sequence length and model size, and a 6-12% improvement in sustained throughput under high concurrency profiles. See linked Linear tickets ENG-6213 and ENG-6348 for benchmarks and rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] unit + integration tests added - [x] perf benchmark harness updated - [x] docs: arena tuning notes - [x] feature guarded by config flags - [x] feature rollout window/monitoring defined (ENG-6348)
commit_summary: 3 commits: 1) refine activation checkpointing allocation pattern and lazy-free pass; 2) arena allocator threshold tuning + eviction heuristics; 3) add scratch buffer pool + tests and docs
review_comments: Lina Chen (2025-11-16): Requested more detail on the eviction heuristic: what metric drives eviction (age vs size) and is there any risk of thrashing under bursty workloads?

Ethan Park (2025-11-16): Reply: eviction now prefers least-recently-used scratch blocks with size-aware coalescing; added unit tests to show no thrash under synthetic burst tests and adjustable target utilization flag (arena.target_utilization).

Marcelo Alvarez (2025-11-17): Asked for a conservative default and a config flag to opt-in for Private installs. Also requested labels for telemetry to track 'arena_evictions' and 'scratch_pool_hits'.

Ethan Park (2025-11-17): Added config gating (runtime.arena_tuning.enabled=false by default for private builds) and added two metrics: runtime.arena_evictions_total and runtime.scratch_pool_hits_total. Updated docs with rollout guidance.
Priya Raman (2025-11-19): Noted a flaky test in CI on gpu_memory_regression_test (race on allocator destructor). Requested a fix to destructor ordering or stronger ownership semantics.
Ethan Park (2025-11-19): Pushed a follow-up commit to use unique_ptr ownership for scratch buffers and added a small stress test for destructor ordering. CI rerun after fix passed.
Lina Chen (2025-11-20): Approve after addressing comments. Marcelo approved with a minor nit on a log message formatting.
